configurePresets.name: vs2022
configurePresets.description: Generate Visual Studio 17 2022 solution files; legacy/optional IDE workflow. New development prefers the "vs2026" preset on hosts with VS 2026, or the "ninja" preset for any host.

configurePresets.name: vs2026
configurePresets.description: Build with the MSVC toolchain from the highest installed Visual Studio (Ninja backend with auto-detection). On hosts whose newest Visual Studio is 2026, Ninja picks MSVC 18.x automatically — no explicit CMAKE_GENERATOR_INSTANCE is required. Equivalent to the 'ninja' preset; provided for naming consistency so users can run `cmake --preset vs2026`.
